shapeVolume.note: Square non-exposed corners close the junction notches; cells read as one mass; chips on groove-side corners read as wear without touching the outline.

color.note: Tops unchanged and good. Regression: several front faces are now a desaturated grey-mauve tan beside warm ochre neighbours (blocker 1).

lightingHighlights.note: Smear fixed: crisp warm chamfer, clean break to the front.

materialDetail.note: Cracks now carved with a pale lip and visible at phone size; chips present. But one short two-stroke motif repeats everywhere and reads as scratches; stepped strata are thin lines that fade at phone size.

artifactFreeReadability.note: Round-01 smudges and blurred groove V-wedges gone; no halos, no cast shadow on the transparent ground. Grey front patches are the remaining visual defect.

observations: Round-01 blocker 2 resolved: front faces are clean, chamfer-to-front transition crisp, front grooves read as thin dark lines.

Round-01 blocker 1 partly resolved: cracks are deeper with a lit lip and survive the downsample; chipped corners and groove-side nicks are visible at native and faintly at phone size; every pattern now has cracked slabs.

Tight corners (coordinator ruling): verified in pixels on reef-03-a and across the assembly. Non-exposed corners are now square (e.g. the NW corner of reef-03-a, N solid/W open), exposed 0.35 corners unchanged; alpha difference vs baseline is only those corners and the groove fill. Cell joins meet flush with no seabed notch. validation: tightCornerOutsideBox 0, chip bite 0.027 and nick bite 0.028 <= 0.03. Accepted.

Soft shadows: no shadow reaches the transparent ground; sprite edges clean on the seabed. But inside cells, fronts of some slabs (typically ones next to a taller/forward in-cell neighbour) turn noticeably greyer and desaturated, e.g. in the mask-15 3x3 of seam-stress-2x the top-right cell's left front, the middle-left cell's left front and the bottom-row second cell's left front. Because shadows are cast only by slabs in the same piece, the same situation across a cell seam gets no shadow, so this darkening is inherently not seam-consistent even if it is not visible as a hard step yet.
Seams otherwise continue to pass: tops, chamfers and strata heights match across every flush cell edge in assembly and stress sheet.

Crack motif: nearly every cracked slab shows the same short pair of strokes (a '\' plus a '|', or a small Y). Seen over the 6x6 patch it reads as stamped claw scratches rather than limestone fracture; the target's cracks are longer, branching, irregular hairlines that sometimes reach an edge.
Strata changed from soft bands to thin stepped lines: cleaner at 2x but at 360 px the fronts read as plain tan; round 01's bands carried more stone identity at phone size.

blockers.location: front (south) faces of slabs beside a taller or forward in-cell neighbour, across many masks (see mask-15 3x3 in seam-stress-2x)
blockers.effect: Grey-mauve, desaturated front patches read as a different dirty material and break the warm tan front (criterion 1); because they come from in-piece shadows they are not seam-consistent across cell edges (criterion 2).
blockers.desired: All fronts in the same warm tan family with only gentle per-slab variation. Either restrict soft shadows so they do not darken neighbouring slab fronts (e.g. contact shadow/occlusion only in the narrow groove), or make any darkening warm and symmetric so a slab looks the same whether its neighbour is in the same cell or across a seam.

blockers.location: crack decals/geometry on slab tops, all patterns
blockers.effect: One repeated two-stroke motif reads as scratches/claw marks and as a stamp across the patch, undermining the 'cracked limestone' read (criterion 3).
blockers.desired: Varied cracks: longer irregular hairlines with one or two short branches, differing in length/angle per slab, some running to a chamfer or groove edge; keep the current carved dark core and pale lip, density about a third to half of slabs, and keep them inside a slab.

blockers.effect: Thin stepped strata lines vanish at phone size, so the front faces lose the banded-stone identity the target shows.
blockers.desired: Keep the clean stepped edges but add a gentle tonal difference between bands (alternating slightly lighter/darker warm tan) so 2-4 bands remain visible at 360 px, aligned in world Z as now.
